description:
modules/parentbilling — GET /traeger/required-details/issuers (#8040, ADR 0322):
the Träger binding of the Träger transaction, the stored Schulträger and
Gemeinde of the Träger's schools in one statement, the settings of those
schools in one batch read, the number ranges, the kinds of document, the
template of the fee notice, the contracts in force with their parties, the
terms with the family deviations and the mandates in force. Flat in the
number of families.
